option top

  top: …;

Drill 3625 — output × contain

output contain

Apply contain to <output> — the result of a form calculation or user action. Limits an element's side effects (layout, paint, size, style) to its subtree.

1 · The element

<output> as rendered
3×4=12

<input type="number" id="a" value="3" aria-label="A">
× <input type="number" id="b" value="4" aria-label="B">
= <output name="result" for="a b">12</output>

3 · Your task

  • Write one CSS rule that applies contain = none to the element.
  • Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.

4 · Solution

output {
  contain: none;
}

}</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Defines a client-side image map: clickable regions on an image.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;isindex&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;map&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;b&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;label&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4546">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4547 / 8000 · Practice 19</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4548">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4548" data-page="4548" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3671"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 19</span><span>Page 4548 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3671 — dialog × z-index</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dialog</span> <span class="badge prop">z-index</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">z-index</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dialog&gt;</code> — a native dialog box: modal when shown with showmodal(), non-modal when shown with show(). Stacking order of positioned elements (higher = on top).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dialog&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="width:240px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18);padding:14px;font-size:13px"><b>Are you sure?</b><div style="margin-top:10px;text-align:right"><button style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f9fafb;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 10px;margin-right:6px;font-size:12px">Cancel</button><button style="border:none;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 12px;font-size:12px">OK</button></div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;dialog id=&quot;dlg&quot;&gt; &lt;form method=&quot;dialog&quot;&gt; &lt;p&gt;Are you sure?&lt;/p&gt; &lt;button value=&quot;cancel&quot;&gt;Cancel&lt;/button&gt; &lt;button formnovalidate&gt;OK&lt;/button&gt; &lt;/form&gt; &lt;/dialog&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>z-index</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dialog { z-index: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “The most versatile form control: text, email, number, date, file, checkbox, radio, range, color, search and more.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;menu&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;input&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;em&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;output&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4547">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4548 / 8000 · Practice 19</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4549">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4549" data-page="4549" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3672"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 19</span><span>Page 4549 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3672 — s × flex-wrap</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">s</span> <span class="badge prop">flex-wrap</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">flex-wrap</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;s&gt;</code> — marks text that is no longer accurate or relevant (not a strikethrough for style). Changes the visual order of an item (without touching HTML).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dfn&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px"><dfn style="font-style:italic"><b>semantics</b></dfn>: the meaning carried by markup, not just its appearance.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;&lt;dfn&gt;semantics&lt;/dfn&gt;: the meaning of markup.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>order</b> = <b>integer</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dfn { order: integer; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A multi-line plain-text input field.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;textarea&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;head&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;q&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;tbody&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4549">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4550 / 8000 · Practice 19</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4551">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4551" data-page="4551" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3674"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 19</span><span>Page 4551 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3674 — sup × place-self</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">sup</span> <span class="badge prop">place-self</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">place-self</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;sup&gt;</code> — superscript text (rendered above the baseline). Use the font&#x27;s optical sizes (automatically pick the right cut).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;ol&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><ol start="2" style="font-size:13px;margin:0;padding-left:22px;line-height:1.7"><li>Second step</li><li>Third step</li></ol></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ol start=&quot;2&quot;&gt; &lt;li&gt;Second step&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Third step&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ol&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font-optical-sizing</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>ol { font-optical-sizing: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “The title/caption of a &lt;table&gt;.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;script&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;caption&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;samp&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;center&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4551">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4552 / 8000 · Practice 19</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4553">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4553" data-page="4553" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3676"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 19</span><span>Page 4553 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3676 — source × text-shadow</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">source</span> <span class="badge prop">text-shadow</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-shadow</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;source&gt;</code> — a candidate resource for &lt;video&gt;, &lt;audio&gt; or &lt;picture&gt;. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Groups the header rows of a table.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;body&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;thead&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;sub&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;blink&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4552">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4553 / 8000 · Practice 19</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4554">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4554" data-page="4554" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3677"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 19</span><span>Page 4554 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3677 — iframe × text-orientation</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">iframe</span> <span class="badge prop">text-orientation</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-orientation</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;iframe&gt;</code> — embeds another html page in a nested browsing context. “The button part of &lt;input type=&quot;file&quot;&gt;.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>::file-selector-button</code></li><li>C. <code>:nth-child(n)</code></li><li>D. <code>:enabled / :disabled</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4644">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4645 / 8000 · Practice 19</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4646">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4646" data-page="4646" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3769"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 19</span><span>Page 4646 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3769 — select × text-decoration-color</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">select</span> <span class="badge prop">text-decoration-color</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-decoration-color</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;select&gt;</code> — a dropdown list of options (single or multiple choice). style=&quot;background:#eef2ff&quot;&gt;&lt;/colgroup&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>translate</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>col { translate: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “The dominant, unique content of the document.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;var&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;main&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;tbody&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;p&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4683">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4684 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4685">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4685" data-page="4685" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3808"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4685 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3808 — font × max-height</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">font</span> <span class="badge prop">max-height</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">max-height</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;font&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: font (obsolete). The upper limit of the height.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;font&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="font-family:serif;color:#ef4444;font-size:13px">Legacy: <font> is dead — use CSS</span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;font face=&quot;Arial&quot; color=&quot;red&quot;&gt;text&lt;/font&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>max-height</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>font { max-height: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “The caption for a &lt;figure&gt;.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;ruby&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;figcaption&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;th&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;wbr&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4684">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4685 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4686">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4686" data-page="4686" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3809"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4686 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3809 — acronym × padding-bottom</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">acronym</span> <span class="badge prop">padding-bottom</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">padding-bottom</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;acronym&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: acronym (obsolete). Inner space at the bottom.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;acronym&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="font-size:13px"><abbr title="World Wide Web" style="text-decoration:underline dotted;cursor:help">WWW</abbr> — use <abbr> now</span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;acronym title=&quot;World Wide Web&quot;&gt;WWW&lt;/acronym&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding-bottom</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>acronym { padding-bottom: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A section heading of importance level 3 (h1 = highest).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;bdi&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;center&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;details&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;h3&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4685">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4686 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4687">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4687" data-page="4687" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3810"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4687 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3810 — nextid × outline</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">nextid</span> <span class="badge prop">outline</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">outline</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;nextid&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: nextid (obsolete). Distributes flex items along the main axis.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;script&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;background:#0d1117;color:#7ee787;padding:10px;border-radius:6px">console.log("hi"); → "hi"</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;script src=&quot;app.js&quot; defer&gt;&lt;/script&gt; &lt;script&gt; console.log(&quot;hi&quot;); &lt;/script&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>justify-content</b> = <b>center</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>script { justify-content: center; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A section quoted from another source.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;picture&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;blockquote&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;noframes&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;s&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4688">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4689 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4690">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4690" data-page="4690" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3813"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4690 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3813 — aside × grid-template-rows</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">aside</span> <span class="badge prop">grid-template-rows</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">grid-template-rows</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;aside&gt;</code> — content tangentially related to the main content (sidebar, box, pull quote). &lt;h3&gt;Did you know?&lt;/h3&gt; &lt;p&gt;HTML5 added 40+ new elements.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/aside&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>grid-template-rows</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>aside { grid-template-rows: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A native dialog box: modal when shown with showModal(), non-modal when shown with show().”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;audio&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;isindex&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;dialog&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;cite&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4689">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4690 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4691">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4691" data-page="4691" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3814"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4691 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3814 — figcaption × justify-self</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">figcaption</span> <span class="badge prop">justify-self</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">justify-self</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;figcaption&gt;</code> — the caption for a &lt;figure&gt;. The browser adds vertical space around it automatically.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;This is a paragraph of text.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>line-height</b> = <b>number</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>p { line-height: number; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Non-extractive information: a spell-check red line, a signature.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;u&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;embed&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;del&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;kbd&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4691">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4692 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4693">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4693" data-page="4693" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3816"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4693 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3816 — summary × text-wrap</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">summary</span> <span class="badge prop">text-wrap</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-wrap</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;summary&gt;</code> — the visible caption of a &lt;details&gt; disclosure. Smooth or instant scrolling for the element (and anchor jumps).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;ul&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><ul style="font-size:13px;margin:0;padding-left:22px;line-height:1.7"><li>HTML</li><li>CSS</li><li>JavaScript</li></ul></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ul&gt; &lt;li&gt;HTML&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;CSS&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;JavaScript&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>scroll-behavior</b> = <b>smooth</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>ul { scroll-behavior: smooth; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Superscript text (rendered above the baseline).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;sup&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;legend&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;article&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;dt&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4696">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4697 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4698">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4698" data-page="4698" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3821"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4698 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3821 — picture × transition</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">picture</span> <span class="badge prop">transition</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">transition</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;picture&gt;</code> — wraps multiple &lt;source&gt; candidates to serve the right image per condition. Shorthand: property + duration + timing-function + delay.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;picture&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:11px;font-family:monospace"><span>≤600px → thumb.jpg</span><span>webp → hero.webp</span><span>fallback → hero.jpg</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;picture&gt; &lt;/picture&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>transition</b> = <b>all .3s ease</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>picture { transition: all .3s ease; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A bitmap drawing surface controlled by the 2D API or WebGL.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;tt&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;wbr&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;input&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;canvas&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4702">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4703 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4704">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4704" data-page="4704" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3827"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4704 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3827 — tt × contain</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">tt</span> <span class="badge prop">contain</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">contain</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;tt&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: teletype (obsolete). Distance to the right of the element.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;code&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Use <code style="font-family:monospace;background:#eef2ff;color:#4338ca;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px">display: grid</code> for layouts.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Use &lt;code&gt;display: grid&lt;/code&gt; for layouts.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>margin-right</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>code { margin-right: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Floats the element left/right; text wraps around it.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>grid-template</code></li><li>B. <code>background-clip</code></li><li>C. <code>animation-direction</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>float</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4731">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4732 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4733">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4733" data-page="4733" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3856"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4733 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3856 — bdi × border-width</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">bdi</span> <span class="badge prop">border-width</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border-width</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;bdi&gt;</code> — isolates text so its direction does not affect surrounding text. The flow direction of the text (horizontal, vertical, and which way).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;ruby&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;font-family:serif"><ruby>中<rt style="font-size:9px">zhōng</rt></ruby>国<rp>(</rp><rt style="font-size:9px">guó</rt><rp>)</rp></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ruby&gt;中&lt;rt&gt;zhōng&lt;/rt&gt;&lt;/ruby&gt;&lt;ruby&gt;国&lt;rt&gt;guó&lt;/rt&gt;&lt;/ruby&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>writing-mode</b> = <b>horizontal-tb</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>ruby { writing-mode: horizontal-tb; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Position along the offset-path (0%–100%).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>bottom</code></li><li>B. <code>font-optical-sizing</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>offset-distance</code></li><li>D. <code>list-style-type</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4786">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4787 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4788">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4788" data-page="4788" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3911"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4788 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3911 — li × opacity</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">li</span> <span class="badge prop">opacity</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">opacity</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;li&gt;</code> — a single item inside &lt;ul&gt;, &lt;ol&gt; or &lt;menu&gt;. The overall transparency of the element (0–1).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;li&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><ol style="font-size:13px;margin:0;padding-left:22px;line-height:1.7"><li>Start</li><li value="10">Jumps to 10</li><li>Then 11</li></ol></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ol&gt; &lt;li&gt;Start&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li value=&quot;10&quot;&gt;Jumps to 10&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Then 11&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ol&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>opacity</b> = <b>0.8</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>li { opacity: 0.8; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches by tag name (p, a, h1…).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>element</code></li><li>B. <code>:focus-visible</code></li><li>C. <code>:last-of-type</code></li><li>D. <code>:placeholder-shown</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4787">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4788 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4789">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4789" data-page="4789" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3912"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4789 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3912 — video × shape-outside</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">video</span> <span class="badge prop">shape-outside</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">shape-outside</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;video&gt;</code> — embeds a video player with optional controls, autoplay, loop and captions. “Matches elements that HAVE the attribute.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>B. <code>:last-child</code></li><li>C. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li><li>D. <code>:lang(code)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4788">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4789 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4790">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4790" data-page="4790" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3913"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4790 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3913 — embed × resize</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">embed</span> <span class="badge prop">resize</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">resize</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;embed&gt;</code> — embeds an external application (legacy plugin interface). Allow the user to resize the element (with overflow ≠ visible).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;embed&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;width:220px;padding:10px;background:#f9fafb;font-size:11px;font-family:monospace">document.pdf<br><span style="color:#6b7280">application/pdf — 100% × 400</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;embed src=&quot;document.pdf&quot; type=&quot;application/pdf&quot; width=&quot;100%&quot; height=&quot;400&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>resize</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>embed { resize: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The value ends with the string.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:nth-of-type(n)</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>[attr$=…]</code></li><li>C. <code>:checked</code></li><li>D. <code>descendant (space)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4789">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4790 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4791">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4791" data-page="4791" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3914"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4791 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3914 — button × appearance</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">button</span> <span class="badge prop">appearance</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">appearance</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;button&gt;</code> — a clickable button: submit, reset, or script-triggered action. Reset or request the native form-control look.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;button&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="display:flex;gap:8px"><button style="background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:7px 16px;font-size:12px">Search (submit)</button><button style="background:#f3f4f6;color:#374151;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:7px 14px;font-size:12px">Clear (button)</button></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;form&gt; &lt;input name=&quot;q&quot; required&gt; &lt;button type=&quot;submit&quot;&gt;Search&lt;/button&gt; &lt;button type=&quot;button&quot; id=&quot;clear&quot;&gt;Clear&lt;/button&gt; &lt;/form&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>appearance</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>button { appearance: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The element is being pressed/clicked.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:where(sel, …)</code></li><li>B. <code>:target</code></li><li>C. <code>::first-line</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:active</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4791">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4792 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4793">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4793" data-page="4793" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3916"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4793 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3916 — thead × perspective-origin</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">thead</span> <span class="badge prop">perspective-origin</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">perspective-origin</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;thead&gt;</code> — groups the header rows of a table. “The sole child of its parent.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:enabled / :disabled</code></li><li>B. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>::marker</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:only-child</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4792">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4793 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4794">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4794" data-page="4794" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3917"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4794 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3917 — center × margin</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">center</span> <span class="badge prop">margin</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">margin</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;center&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: center (obsolete). Logical top+bottom padding.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;frame&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;background:#fef2f2;border:1px solid #fecaca;border-radius:6px;padding:8px">frameset/frame → dead since HTML5. Use <iframe> or real CSS layout.</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;frameset&gt;&lt;frame src=&quot;nav.html&quot;&gt;&lt;frame src=&quot;main.html&quot;&gt;&lt;/frameset&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding-block</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>frame { padding-block: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Everything EXCEPT the selector inside.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:lang(code)</code></li><li>B. <code>::first-letter</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:not(sel)</code></li><li>D. <code>.class</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4794">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4795 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4796">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4796" data-page="4796" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3919"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4796 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3919 — dir × float</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dir</span> <span class="badge prop">float</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">float</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dir&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: directory list (obsolete). Floats the element left/right; text wraps around it.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dir&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px">Use <ul>/<ol> and style with CSS list-style.</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;dir&gt;&lt;item&gt;a&lt;/item&gt;&lt;item&gt;b&lt;/item&gt;&lt;/dir&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>float</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dir { float: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Parent selector! Matches if it CONTAINS the selector.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:has(sel)</code></li><li>B. <code>descendant (space)</code></li><li>C. <code>::placeholder</code></li><li>D. <code>[attr=value]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4795">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4796 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4797">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4797" data-page="4797" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3920"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4797 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3920 — head × visibility</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">head</span> <span class="badge prop">visibility</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">visibility</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;head&gt;</code> — container for all machine-oriented information about the document. Show or hide an element while keeping its space.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;head&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;background:#f6f8fa;padding:10px;border:1px solid #d0d7de">&lt;head&gt; = title + meta + link + style + script (invisible)</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;head&gt; &lt;meta charset=&quot;UTF-8&quot;&gt; &lt;title&gt;My Page&lt;/title&gt; &lt;/head&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>visibility</b> = <b>hidden</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>head { visibility: hidden; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Field required or not.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::before</code></li><li>B. <code>::file-selector-button</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:required / :optional</code></li><li>D. <code>[attr*=…]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4796">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4797 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4798">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4798" data-page="4798" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3921"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4798 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3921 — noscript × align-self</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">noscript</span> <span class="badge prop">align-self</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">align-self</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;noscript&gt;</code> — content rendered only when scripting is disabled or unsupported. Overrides align-items for one item.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;noscript&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;background:#fff8e1;border:1px solid #ffe082;color:#795548;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:6px">⚠ You need to enable JavaScript to view this map.</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;noscript&gt;You need to enable JavaScript to view this map.&lt;/noscript&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>align-self</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>noscript { align-self: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Number input within / outside min-max.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::first-line</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:in-range / :out-of-range</code></li><li>C. <code>element</code></li><li>D. <code>:focus</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4797">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4798 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4799">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4799" data-page="4799" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3922"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4799 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3922 — nav × grid-row</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">nav</span> <span class="badge prop">grid-row</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">grid-row</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;nav&gt;</code> — a major block of navigation links. Spans grid rows (shorthand: row-start / row-end).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;nav&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><nav style="background:#1f2937;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 4px;display:flex;gap:4px"><a href="#" style="color:#d1d5db;font-size:12px;text-decoration:none;padding:6px 10px;background:#374151;border-radius:6px">Home</a><a href="#" style="color:#d1d5db;font-size:12px;text-decoration:none;padding:6px 10px">About</a><a href="#" style="color:#d1d5db;font-size:12px;text-decoration:none;padding:6px 10px">Contact</a></nav></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;nav&gt; &lt;ul&gt; &lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;/&quot;&gt;Home&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;/about&quot;&gt;About&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt; &lt;/nav&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>grid-row</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>nav { grid-row: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Element&#x27;s text direction matches.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:dir(dir)</code></li><li>B. <code>::marker</code></li><li>C. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>D. <code>:first-child</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4798">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4799 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4800">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4800" data-page="4800" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3923"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4800 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3923 — h1 × font-size</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">h1</span> <span class="badge prop">font-size</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-size</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;h1&gt;</code> — a section heading of importance level 1 (h1 = highest). The size of the text.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;h1&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-weight:700;font-size:23.5px;line-height:1.25;margin:2px 0">Heading level 1</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;h1&gt;Heading level 1&lt;/h1&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font-size</b> = <b>em</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>h1 { font-size: em; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The NEXT sibling, immediately after.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::cue</code></li><li>B. <code>[attr$=…]</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>+</code></li><li>D. <code>:nth-child(n)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4799">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4800 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4801">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4801" data-page="4801" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3924"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4801 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3924 — hr × text-align</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">hr</span> <span class="badge prop">text-align</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-align</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;hr&gt;</code> — a thematic break between paragraphs (scene change, topic shift). Horizontal alignment of inline content in a block.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;hr&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px"><p style="margin:0 0 6px">Before the break.</p><hr style="border:none;border-top:2px solid #d1d5db;margin:8px 0"><p style="margin:0">After the break.</p></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Before the break.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;hr&gt; &lt;p&gt;After the break.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-align</b> = <b>justify</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>hr { text-align: justify; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Generated content INSIDE the end of the element.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>.class</code></li><li>B. <code>:hover</code></li><li>C. <code>:last-of-type</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>::after</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4800">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4801 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4802">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4802" data-page="4802" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3925"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4802 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3925 — dialog × word-break</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dialog</span> <span class="badge prop">word-break</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">word-break</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dialog&gt;</code> — a native dialog box: modal when shown with showmodal(), non-modal when shown with show(). Where long words may break.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dialog&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="width:240px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18);padding:14px;font-size:13px"><b>Are you sure?</b><div style="margin-top:10px;text-align:right"><button style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f9fafb;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 10px;margin-right:6px;font-size:12px">Cancel</button><button style="border:none;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 12px;font-size:12px">OK</button></div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;dialog id=&quot;dlg&quot;&gt; &lt;form method=&quot;dialog&quot;&gt; &lt;p&gt;Are you sure?&lt;/p&gt; &lt;button value=&quot;cancel&quot;&gt;Cancel&lt;/button&gt; &lt;button formnovalidate&gt;OK&lt;/button&gt; &lt;/form&gt; &lt;/dialog&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>word-break</b> = <b>normal</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dialog { word-break: normal; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The user&#x27;s text selection.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>[attr=value]</code></li><li>B. <code>:active</code></li><li>C. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>::selection</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4801">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4802 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4803">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4803" data-page="4803" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3926"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4803 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3926 — s × background-image</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">s</span> <span class="badge prop">background-image</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background-image</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;s&gt;</code> — marks text that is no longer accurate or relevant (not a strikethrough for style). Real-time image effects on the element (blur, brightness, grayscale…).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dfn&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px"><dfn style="font-style:italic"><b>semantics</b></dfn>: the meaning carried by markup, not just its appearance.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;&lt;dfn&gt;semantics&lt;/dfn&gt;: the meaning of markup.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>filter</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dfn { filter: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of display?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>block</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>inline</code></li><li>C. <code>banana</code></li><li>D. <code>solid2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4803">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4804 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4805">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4805" data-page="4805" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3928"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4805 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3928 — sup × counter-reset</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">sup</span> <span class="badge prop">counter-reset</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">counter-reset</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;sup&gt;</code> — superscript text (rendered above the baseline). Enable scroll snapping on a container (x, y, both).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;ol&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><ol start="2" style="font-size:13px;margin:0;padding-left:22px;line-height:1.7"><li>Second step</li><li>Third step</li></ol></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ol start=&quot;2&quot;&gt; &lt;li&gt;Second step&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Third step&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ol&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>scroll-snap-type</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>ol { scroll-snap-type: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of border-collapse?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>collapse</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>separate</code></li><li>C. <code>auto2</code></li><li>D. <code>never</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4805">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4806 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4807">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4807" data-page="4807" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3930"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4807 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3930 — source × transition-timing-function</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">source</span> <span class="badge prop">transition-timing-function</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">transition-timing-function</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;source&gt;</code> — a candidate resource for &lt;video&gt;, &lt;audio&gt; or &lt;picture&gt;. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of vertical-align?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>baseline</code></li><li>B. <code>auto9</code></li><li>C. <code>banana</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>middle</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4815">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4816 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4817">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4817" data-page="4817" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3940"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4817 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3940 — aside × text-decoration-thickness</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">aside</span> <span class="badge prop">text-decoration-thickness</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-decoration-thickness</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;aside&gt;</code> — content tangentially related to the main content (sidebar, box, pull quote). Base text direction of the element (ltr / rtl).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;figcaption&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:11px;color:#6b7280;border-top:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding-top:4px;width:250px">Sunrise in Cairo — <i>the figcaption</i></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;figure&gt;&lt;img src=&quot;a.png&quot;&gt;&lt;figcaption&gt;Sunrise in Cairo&lt;/figcaption&gt;&lt;/figure&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>direction</b> = <b>ltr</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>figcaption { direction: ltr; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of writing-mode?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>vertical-rl</code></li><li>B. <code>solid2</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>horizontal-tb</code></li><li>D. <code>auto2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4817">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4818 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4819">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4819" data-page="4819" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3942"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4819 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3942 — p × background-clip</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">p</span> <span class="badge prop">background-clip</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background-clip</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;p&gt;</code> — a block of text — the basic unit of written content. How far the background is painted (border-box / padding-box / content-box / text).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;p&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6">A <b>&lt;p&gt;</b> is a paragraph. The browser adds vertical space around it automatically.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;This is a paragraph of text.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>background-clip</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>p { background-clip: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of background-attachment?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>fixed</code></li><li>B. <code>always</code></li><li>C. <code>banana2</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>scroll</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4818">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4819 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4820">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4820" data-page="4820" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3943"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4820 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3943 — summary × clip-path</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">summary</span> <span class="badge prop">clip-path</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">clip-path</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;summary&gt;</code> — the visible caption of a &lt;details&gt; disclosure. Locks the width:height ratio (16/9, 1/1, 4/3…).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;picture&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:11px;font-family:monospace"><span>≤600px → thumb.jpg</span><span>webp → hero.webp</span><span>fallback → hero.jpg</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;picture&gt; &lt;source media=&quot;(max-width: 600px)&quot; srcset=&quot;thumb.jpg&quot;&gt; &lt;source type=&quot;image/webp&quot; srcset=&quot;hero.webp&quot;&gt; &lt;img src=&quot;hero.jpg&quot; alt=&quot;Hero&quot;&gt; &lt;/picture&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>aspect-ratio</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>picture { aspect-ratio: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “Makes the element&#x27;s content editable in place. true / false / plaintext-only. The browser shows a plain text-editing UI.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>inert</code></li><li>B. <code>itemtype</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>contenteditable</code></li><li>D. <code>slot</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4824">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4825 / 8000 · Practice 20</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4826">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4826" data-page="4826" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 3949"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 20</span><span>Page 4826 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 3949 — math × padding-inline</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">math</span> <span class="badge prop">padding-inline</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">padding-inline</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;math&gt;</code> — mathematical notation using mathml. Logical left+right padding (flips with direction).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;math&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:serif;font-size:16px;text-align:center;padding:6px"><span style="display:inline-block;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle"><span style="display:block;border-bottom:1px solid #333;padding:0 4px 2px">a</span><span style="display:block;padding:2px 4px 0">b</span></span> = <span style="display:inline-block;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle"><span style="display:block;border-bottom:1px solid #333;padding:0 4px 2px">c</span><span style="display:block;padding:2px 4px 0">d</span></span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;math display=&quot;block&quot;&gt;&lt;mfrac&gt;&lt;mi&gt;a&lt;/mi&gt;&lt;mi&gt;b&lt;/mi&gt;&lt;/mfrac&gt;&lt;mo&gt;=&lt;/mo&gt;&lt;mfrac&gt;&lt;mi&gt;c&lt;/mi&gt;&lt;mi&gt;d&lt;/mi&gt;&lt;/mfrac&gt;&lt;/math&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding-inline</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>math { padding-inline: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “Whether the element can be dragged (HTML5 Drag &amp; Drop API). true / false. One or more shadows around the box.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;form&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><form style="display:flex;gap:6px"><input placeholder="Search…" style="flex:1;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 10px;font-size:12px"><button style="background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 14px;font-size:12px">Search</button></form></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;form action=&quot;/search&quot; method=&quot;get&quot;&gt; &lt;input name=&quot;q&quot; placeholder=&quot;Search…&quot; required&gt; &lt;button type=&quot;submit&quot;&gt;Search&lt;/button&gt; &lt;/form&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>box-shadow</b> = <b>multiple</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>form { box-shadow: multiple; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “Hint for the mobile virtual keyboard: none, text, search, tel, url, email, numeric, decimal, telephone.
