as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:11px;color:#6b7280;border-top:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding-top:4px;width:250px">Sunrise in Cairo — <i>the figcaption</i></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;figure&gt;&lt;img src=&quot;a.png&quot;&gt;&lt;figcaption&gt;Sunrise in Cairo&lt;/figcaption&gt;&lt;/figure&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>content</b> = <b>string</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>figcaption { content: string; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Move the element along an SVG path (motion path).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>offset-path</code></li><li>B. <code>top</code></li><li>C. <code>font-kerning</code></li><li>D. <code>list-style</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4944">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4945 / 8000 · Practice 21</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4946">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4946" data-page="4946" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4069"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 21</span><span>Page 4946 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4069 — p × scroll-snap-stop</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">p</span> <span class="badge prop">scroll-snap-stop</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">scroll-snap-stop</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;p&gt;</code> — a block of text — the basic unit of written content. Whether the scroller must stop at every snap point (normal) or can skip (always).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;p&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6">A <b>&lt;p&gt;</b> is a paragraph. The browser adds vertical space around it automatically.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;This is a paragraph of text.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>scroll-snap-stop</b> = <b>normal</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>p { scroll-snap-stop: normal; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches every element.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:focus</code></li><li>B. <code>:first-of-type</code></li><li>C. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>*</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4945">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4946 / 8000 · Practice 21</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4947">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4947" data-page="4947" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4070"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 21</span><span>Page 4947 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4070 — summary × animation</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">summary</span> <span class="badge prop">animation</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">animation</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;summary&gt;</code> — the visible caption of a &lt;details&gt; disclosure. Shorthand: name + duration + timing + delay + iteration + direction + fill-mode + play-state.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;summary&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px">Click ▸ <b>FAQ</b> to expand — <i>summary is the label</i></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;details&gt;&lt;summary&gt;FAQ&lt;/summary&gt;&lt;p&gt;Answer...&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/details&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>animation</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>summary { animation: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches by unique id.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>#id</code></li><li>B. <code>:first-child</code></li><li>C. <code>:not(sel)</code></li><li>D. <code>:target</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4946">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4947 / 8000 · Practice 21</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4948">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4948" data-page="4948" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4071"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 21</span><span>Page 4948 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4071 — u × transform-origin</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">u</span> <span class="badge prop">transform-origin</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">transform-origin</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;u&gt;</code> — non-extractive information: a spell-check red line, a signature. The point transforms rotate/scale around.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;u&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">My name is <u>Ali</u>. — underlined, no meaning</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;My name is &lt;u&gt;Ali&lt;/u&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>transform-origin</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>u { transform-origin: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The value starts with the string.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:nth-child(n)</code></li><li>B. <code>:has(sel)</code></li><li>C. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>[attr^=…]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4947">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4948 / 8000 · Practice 21</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4949">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4949" data-page="4949" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4072"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 21</span><span>Page 4949 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4072 — data × max-width</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">data</span> <span class="badge prop">max-width</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">max-width</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;data&gt;</code> — a machine-readable value behind human-readable text. The upper limit of the width.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;data&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Weight: <span title="85">85 kg</span> — value="85" is stored for machines</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Weight: &lt;data value=&quot;85&quot;&gt;85 kg&lt;/data&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>max-width</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>data { max-width: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches an element in a state.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:last-of-type</code></li><li>B. <code>:required / :optional</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:</code></li><li>D. <code>~</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4948">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4949 / 8000 · Practice 21</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4950">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4950" data-page="4950" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4073"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 21</span><span>Page 4950 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4073 — sub × padding-top</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">sub</span> <span class="badge prop">padding-top</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">padding-top</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;sub&gt;</code> — subscript text (rendered below the baseline). Inner space at the top (inside the border).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;sub&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">H<sub>2</sub>O and x<sub>1</sub></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;H&lt;sub&gt;2&lt;/sub&gt;O and x&lt;sub&gt;1&lt;/sub&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding-top</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>sub { padding-top: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Focus via keyboard (not mouse click).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:focus-visible</code></li><li>B. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li><li>C. <code>:in-range / :out-of-range</code></li><li>D. <code>::first-letter</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4949">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4950 / 8000 · Practice 21</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4951">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4951" data-page="4951" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4074"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 21</span><span>Page 4951 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4074 — ul × border-collapse</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">ul</span> <span class="badge prop">border-collapse</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border-collapse</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;ul&gt;</code> — a bulleted list of items. Merges adjacent table borders into one.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;ul&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><ul style="font-size:13px;margin:0;padding-left:22px;line-height:1.7"><li>HTML</li><li>CSS</li><li>JavaScript</li></ul></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ul&gt; &lt;li&gt;HTML&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;CSS&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;JavaScript&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>border-collapse</b> = <b>separate</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>ul { border-collapse: separate; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Last child of its parent.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:last-child</code></li><li>B. <code>:checked</code></li><li>C. <code>:dir(dir)</code></li><li>D. <code>::placeholder</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4950">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4951 / 8000 · Practice 21</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4952">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4952" data-page="4952" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4075"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 21</span><span>Page 4952 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4075 — picture × z-index</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">picture</span> <span class="badge prop">z-index</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">z-index</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;picture&gt;</code> — wraps multiple &lt;source&gt; candidates to serve the right image per condition. Stacking order of positioned elements (higher = on top).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;picture&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:11px;font-family:monospace"><span>≤600px → thumb.jpg</span><span>webp → hero.webp</span><span>fallback → hero.jpg</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;picture&gt; &lt;source media=&quot;(max-width: 600px)&quot; srcset=&quot;thumb.jpg&quot;&gt; &lt;source type=&quot;image/webp&quot; srcset=&quot;hero.webp&quot;&gt; &lt;img src=&quot;hero.jpg&quot; alt=&quot;Hero&quot;&gt; &lt;/picture&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>z-index</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>picture { z-index: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The n-th child OF ITS TAG type (ignores other tags).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:nth-of-type(n)</code></li><li>C. <code>+</code></li><li>D. <code>::file-selector-button</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4951">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4952 / 8000 · Practice 21</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4953">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4953" data-page="4953" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4076"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 21</span><span>Page 4953 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4076 — math × flex-wrap</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">math</span> <span class="badge prop">flex-wrap</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">flex-wrap</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;math&gt;</code> — mathematical notation using mathml. Whether flex items wrap to multiple lines.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;math&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:serif;font-size:16px;text-align:center;padding:6px"><span style="display:inline-block;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle"><span style="display:block;border-bottom:1px solid #333;padding:0 4px 2px">a</span><span style="display:block;padding:2px 4px 0">b</span></span> = <span style="display:inline-block;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle"><span style="display:block;border-bottom:1px solid #333;padding:0 4px 2px">c</span><span style="display:block;padding:2px 4px 0">d</span></span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;math display=&quot;block&quot;&gt;&lt;mfrac&gt;&lt;mi&gt;a&lt;/mi&gt;&lt;mi&gt;b&lt;/mi&gt;&lt;/mfrac&gt;&lt;mo&gt;=&lt;/mo&gt;&lt;mfrac&gt;&lt;mi&gt;c&lt;/mi&gt;&lt;mi&gt;d&lt;/mi&gt;&lt;/mfrac&gt;&lt;/math&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>flex-wrap</b> = <b>wrap</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>math { flex-wrap: wrap; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “No children at all (not even text).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:target</code></li><li>B. <code>::after</code></li><li>C. <code>element</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:empty</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4952">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4953 / 8000 · Practice 21</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4954">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4954" data-page="4954" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4077"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 21</span><span>Page 4954 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4077 — form × order</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">form</span> <span class="badge prop">order</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">order</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;form&gt;</code> — a section for user input, submitted to a server. Changes the visual order of an item (without touching HTML).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;form&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><form style="display:flex;gap:6px"><input placeholder="Search…" style="flex:1;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 10px;font-size:12px"><button style="background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 14px;font-size:12px">Search</button></form></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;form action=&quot;/search&quot; method=&quot;get&quot;&gt; &lt;input name=&quot;q&quot; placeholder=&quot;Search…&quot; required&gt; &lt;button type=&quot;submit&quot;&gt;Search&lt;/button&gt; &lt;/form&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>order</b> = <b>integer</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>form { order: integer; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Like :is but with ZERO specificity.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>::selection</code></li><li>C. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:where(sel, …)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4953">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4954 / 8000 · Practice 21</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4955">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4955" data-page="4955" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4078"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 21</span><span>Page 4955 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4078 — textarea × place-self</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">textarea</span> <span class="badge prop">place-self</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">place-self</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;textarea&gt;</code> — a multi-line plain-text input field. Shorthand: align-self + justify-self (one item).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;textarea&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;max-width:220px"><b style="font-size:11px">Message</b><div style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 8px;color:#9ca3af;min-height:44px">Write here…</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;label&gt;Message &lt;textarea rows=&quot;3&quot; maxlength=&quot;200&quot; placeholder=&quot;Write here…&quot;&gt;&lt;/textarea&gt; &lt;/label&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>place-self</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>textarea { place-self: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? Distance above the element (outside its border).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;details&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><details open style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 12px;font-size:13px;width:240px"><summary><b>What is HTML?</b></summary><p style="margin:6px 0 0">The markup language of the web.</p></details></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;details&gt; &lt;summary&gt;What is HTML?&lt;/summary&gt; &lt;p&gt;The markup language of the web.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/details&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>margin-top</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>details { margin-top: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of clear?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>both</code></li><li>B. <code>solid2</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>none</code></li><li>D. <code>auto2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4964">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4965 / 8000 · Practice 21</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4966">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4966" data-page="4966" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4089"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 21</span><span>Page 4966 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4089 — em × border</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">em</span> <span class="badge prop">border</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;em&gt;</code> — marks stress emphasis — change in meaning if removed. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “Assigns the element to a named &lt;slot&gt; in a shadow DOM template.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>translate</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>slot</code></li><li>C. <code>required</code></li><li>D. <code>accesskey</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4988">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4989 / 8000 · Practice 21</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4990">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4990" data-page="4990" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4113"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 21</span><span>Page 4990 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4113 — map × opacity</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">map</span> <span class="badge prop">opacity</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">opacity</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;map&gt;</code> — defines a client-side image map: clickable regions on an image. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “Mobile keyboards: off / sentences / words / characters — auto-capitalization behavior.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>required</code></li><li>B. <code>accesskey</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>autocapitalize</code></li><li>D. <code>hidden</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4990">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4991 / 8000 · Practice 21</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4992">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4992" data-page="4992" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4115"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 21</span><span>Page 4992 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4115 — table × resize</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">table</span> <span class="badge prop">resize</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">resize</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;table&gt;</code> — a two-dimensional table of data. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “Disables a form control: not clickable, not submitted, greyed by default.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>disabled</code></li><li>B. <code>name</code></li><li>C. <code>data-…</code></li><li>D. <code>is</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4991">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4992 / 8000 · Practice 21</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4993">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4993" data-page="4993" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4116"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 21</span><span>Page 4993 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4116 — tr × appearance</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">tr</span> <span class="badge prop">appearance</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">appearance</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;tr&gt;</code> — a single row inside a table body/head/footer. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Contains all the visible content of the HTML document.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;body&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;q&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;fieldset&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;figure&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4997">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4998 / 8000 · Practice 21</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p4999">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p4999" data-page="4999" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4122"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 21</span><span>Page 4999 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4122 — main × visibility</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">main</span> <span class="badge prop">visibility</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">visibility</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;main&gt;</code> — the dominant, unique content of the document. &lt;article&gt;...the post...&lt;/article&gt; &lt;/main&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>visibility</b> = <b>collapse</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>main { visibility: collapse; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A complete, independent piece of content that makes sense on its own.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;dfn&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;table&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;article&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;h2&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4998">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 4999 / 8000 · Practice 21</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5000">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5000" data-page="5000" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4123"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 21</span><span>Page 5000 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4123 — h4 × align-self</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">h4</span> <span class="badge prop">align-self</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">align-self</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;h4&gt;</code> — a section heading of importance level 4 (h1 = highest). }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Introductory content or a set of navigational links for a section or page.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;samp&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;col&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;header&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;h5&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p4999">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5000 / 8000 · Practice 21</span> <a data-nav="next" href="../volumes/vol-11.html#p5001">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <script> (function(){ var pageEl = document.querySelector('.page[data-page]'); if(!pageEl) return; // hash scroll function goHash(){ if(location.hash){ var t = document.querySelector(location.hash); if(t) t.scrollIntoView(); } } window.addEventListener('load', goHash); window.addEventListener('hashchange', goHash); // keyboard document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.target.matches('input,textarea')) return; if(e.key === 'ArrowRight'){ var n = document.querySelector('a[data-nav="next"]'); if(n) n.click(); } if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft'){ var p = document.querySelector('a[data-nav="prev"]'); if(p) p.click(); } }); // jump (every page has one) var boxes = document.querySelectorAll('.jump-input'); for(var bi = 0; bi < boxes.length; bi++){ (function(box){ box.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key !== 'Enter') return; var n = parseInt(box.value, 10); if(!n || n < 1 || n > 8000){ box.value=''; box.placeholder='1–8000'; return; } var vol = Math.ceil(n / 500); location.href = 'vol-' + String(vol).padStart(2, '0') + '.html' + '#p' + n; }); })(boxes[bi]); } })(); </script> </body> </html>
